evidence.title: GitHub - stripe/ai: One-stop shop for building AI-powered products and businesses with Stripe. · GitHub

name: Stripe AI
summary: SDKs, a remote MCP server and agent skills for building AI products and businesses with Stripe billing.
description: A collection of SDKs that connect Stripe billing to LLM apps: @stripe/ai-sdk for Vercel's AI SDK and @stripe/token-meter for the native OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Gemini SDKs. It also hosts a remote MCP server at mcp.stripe.com (OAuth-secured, usable by chats and autonomous agents), agent skills and plugins for popular coding agents, and a manual install path for the skills.
contains: SDKs: @stripe/ai-sdk (Vercel AI SDK) and @stripe/token-meter (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini)
remote MCP server at mcp.stripe.com, OAuth-secured
agent skills and plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Build
manually installed skills update with npx skills update -y
